scope: Proposition 9.1 (Fourth-order growth) of the manuscript “A positive resolution of De Giorgi's conjecture in dimension eight” (preprints/De-Giorgis-conjecture-in-dimension-eight-September-26-2026/article.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 375 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6c92e90f31e12f32), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 66. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: In the seven-dimensional stable setting above, fix the penalty Γ sufficiently close to the choices specified in Section 7, with η0 < 10−4 and G1 − 1, (1 − δ2)−1 − 1 < 10−3, decreasing these errors if required by Section 10. There are a finite P, a positive δ, and constants R0, C < ∞ such that, for every solution in the setting above, every xc ∈ ℝ7, every maximal net 𝒳, and every R ≥ R0, 𝒴R := ∫ Σg χ2 (a4 + D2 + E2 ) + NR ≤ CK(R)Rm−4 . (9.1) The constants depend on the fixed penalty and tolerances, including δ, but are independent of the solution, the center, the net, and R. Any prescribed smaller positive tolerances in (8.1)–(8.3) and (8.18)–(8.19) may be imposed before P and δ are fixed.
